hook.text: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,

short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Shona, in Divine Voice™ Color — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. A complete 66-book Shona Bible (Bhaibheri rechiShona), paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Iri ndiro Bhaibheri rokutanga rakadhindwa raunogona kuona kuti ndiani ari kutaura. Mashoko aBaba vedu ari muruvara BHURUU, oMwanakomana muruvara TSVUKU, oMweya muruvara PEPURU.

Kwemakore anopfuura zana, mavara matsvuku akaratidza panotaura Mwanakomana. Asi Baba vedu vanotaura zvakawanda kupfuura izvozvo — muBhaibheri iri rechiShona mashoko 85,452 mumavhesi 5,609 — uye kusvikira zvino mashoko avo ose akadhindwa neingi nhema imwe chete semadzinza. Vanga vachitaura nguva yose; hapana Bhaibheri rakambokuratidza kupi.

Ruvara chiratidzo chokuva muridzi, kwete chokunokora. Mashoko aBaba vedu anoramba ari avo pamuromo upi zvawo unoatakura nokutendeka; mashoko avasina kumbotaura haapiwi ruvara; rondedzero inoramba iri nhema.

Vadzidzi pavakabvunza kuti vangonyengetera sei, Mwanakomana akavapa Baba: “Baba vedu vari kudenga, zita renyu ngarikudzwe seritsvene” (Mateo 6:9). NoMweya tinodana tichiti: “Abha! Baba!” (VaRoma 8:15).
Havasi kure. Havana kuodzwa mwoyo newe. Ndivo Baba vako vari kudenga, uye iwe uri mwana wavo anodiwa. Kana shoko rokuti ‘baba’ risiri shoko renyaradzo kwauri, Bhaibheri iri nderako zvikuru.
Bhaibheri rakazara muvhoriyamu imwe — mabhuku 66, zvitsauko 1,189, mavhesi 31,087. Sumo pabhuku rimwe nerimwe, zvinyorwa 1,361 zvomuverengi, uye peji yokutsaurira zita romunhu waunoripa.

Shanduro yakatendeka kubva muchiHebheru, chiAramu nechiGiriki zvepakutanga; shanduro imwe neimwe inoshandurwa kubva muFather’s Heart Bible™. Chivharo chePepa nechivharo chakaoma, rakadhindwa nemavara.
Kumhuri imwe neimwe nekereke inotaura chiShona — muZimbabwe, muMozambique uye pasi rose — kuti vanzwe inzwi raBaba nomutauro wavo.
Gamuchira Baba vako. Nzwa inzwi ravo. Mwoyo wavo ndewako.

faq.q: Is the Shona edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Shona, 1048 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Shona edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Shona edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Shona text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Shona Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/sn.
